card.name: The -d in hyphenated dose compounds
card.fires_on: The "d" piece after a hyphen in compounds ending in "-dose", such as single-dose, high-dose, reduced-dose and intermediate-dose. It appears in drug labels, mostly for single-dose vials and containers.

modes.label: Single-dose packaging

modes.label: Dose-level modifiers
modes.description: The "-d" of "high-dose", "reduced-dose" or "intermediate-dose" before a drug or therapy.
